question: Mother Teresa was canonized by Pope Francis I on September 4, _____.
solution:
The correct answer is **__2016__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On 4 September 2016, Mother Teresa was canonized as a saint by Pope Francis at a grand ceremony at the Vatican**.
 
• Mother Teresa, a renowned and celebrated nun, who served thousands of diseased and destitute people in Kolkata was canonized by** Pope Francis** at a grand ceremony in the Vatican. 
 
 
• The event saw lakhs of pilgrims, including those from India, reaching the venue to witness the ceremony. 
 
• A 12-member delegation led by the **Minister of External Affairs ****Sushma Swaraj and a delegation from West Bengal and New Delhi including Mamata Banerjee and Arvind Kejriwal** also became a part of the event.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mother Mary Teresa Bojaxhiu**, honoured in the Catholic Church as Saint Teresa of Calcutta, was an Albanian-Indian Roman Catholic nun and missionary. 

 
 
• She was born in Skopje, then part of the Kosovo Vilayet of the Ottoman Empire.
 
• During her lifetime Mother Teresa became famous as the Catholic nun who dedicated her life to caring for the destitute and dying in the slums of Calcutta - now known as Kolkata.
